settings.heading: Smooth moves.
settings.body: A cream that spreads easily and absorbs quickly, without a waxy coating.

settings.heading: Every ingredient has a job.
settings.body: Odour control, moisture absorption and skin feel. No baking soda, waxes or fillers.

settings.heading: A different kind of tube.
settings.body: Metal packaging and a small squeeze. A considered alternative to the usual plastic stick.

settings.heading: Squeeze a little.
settings.body: Start with a pea-sized amount on your fingertip or a small spoon.

settings.heading: Swipe it on.
settings.body: Apply to your underarms, then massage it in.

settings.heading: Find your rhythm.
settings.body: Start small and adjust the amount if needed.

settings.heading: Control odour.
settings.body: Magnesium hydroxide helps neutralise odour. Zinc ricinoleate helps trap it.

settings.heading: Absorb moisture.
settings.body: Tapioca starch and kaolin help absorb moisture and give the cream a drier feel.

settings.heading: Keep it smooth.
settings.body: Fractionated coconut oil gives the formula glide. Sunflower oil helps soften skin.

settings.heading: Hold it together.
settings.body: Plant-based thickeners and olive-derived ingredients help keep the texture creamy and even.
